description: Edge lists of all 11-neuron graphs in 'Does Connectome Wiring Help a Recurrent Controller? A Test Against Typed Degree-Preserving Nulls' (AAAI-27 Student Abstract).
conventions: Chemical synapses are directed (pre -> post). Each gap junction is listed once as an undirected pair and is used reciprocally. Neuron indices follow generate_circuits/tw_pure.bnn of the neuronal_circuit_policies repository (Lechner et al.); only topology and polarity are used.

families.typed_null: Typed degree-preserving nulls of TW (first six pre-drawn graphs)
families.ablation_rewired: Post hoc ablation: each total-preserving null after typed double-edge swaps
families.ablation_motor_narrowed: Post hoc ablation: first four total-preserving nulls with motor inputs narrowed as in TW
